text: For m2-fixed seed 22 on data_seed 1, both arms gain about 0.002 force R² per 500 steps from step 6000 to step 12000, and the layer-1 N=64 minus N=128 gap holds at about 0.086-0.089. If both arms are plotted against log(val_mse_ratio) rather than training step, are the force curves parallel with a constant offset of at least 0.04 (a ceiling difference), or do they converge (a convergence lag)?
